title: Lasted 6 months.. Not worth it.
text:
Lasted 6 months.. Not worth it.. Everything was fine, up until 6 months on the nose from when it arrived. Now it will not do K-cups anymore, but will ONLY send water through the grounds dispenser, making the large supply of kcups we have kinda useless.

Now we have to find a new coffee maker. Will not buy one like this again. Would rather spend more than have to keep buying them every few months.
